bagPolicy.summary: The arena FAQ reports no general bag ban; individual concerts may impose a limit, so consult the concert page.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The arena recommends public transport because event traffic and construction can limit nearby parking.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Guests using accessible transport services can be dropped off and picked up in front of Quality Hotel Globe.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Kiosks and fast-food stands operate on all arena levels; the venue is cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair seating is available at Stand A; contact the venue ticket support for accessible bookings.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No. Once you've entered and leave, you can't come back in, because your ticket has already been used.

ticketPickup.summary: If tickets are still available, you can buy and pick them up at the ticket counter at Avicii Arena on Globentorget 2, which is generally open during events. Phone tickets scan at the entrance as long as the screen is undamaged; if you have both an app ticket and a PDF, use the app.

gates.summary: Scan your ticket from the Stockholm Live app at the entrance, and charge your phone before you arrive. If your ticket won't scan, the ticketing office can help; Avicii Arena's ticket counter is on Globentorget 2. Door times vary by event, so check your event page.
